+use crate::{edits::*, model::*, structure::*, text::*};

+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,

+    b: Unit,
+    method: &str,
+    score: Option<f64>,
+) {
+    ul.insert(a.id.clone());
+    ur.insert(b.id.clone());

+        a,
+        b,

+}
+fn group(
+    us: &[Unit],

+    key: impl Fn(&Unit) -> Option<String>,
+) -> Map<String, Vec<Unit>> {
+    let mut m: Map<String, Vec<Unit>> = Map::new();
+    for u in us {
+        if used.contains(&u.id) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if let Some(k) = key(u) {
+            m.entry(k).or_default().push(u.clone())
+        }
+    }

+}
+fn mark(used: &mut Set<String>, us: &[Unit]) {

+}
+fn unresolved(reason: &str, message: &str, a: &[Unit], b: &[Unit], l: &Doc, r: &Doc) -> V {
+    json!({"reason":reason,"message":message,"left":a.iter().flat_map(|u|u.loc(l,"left")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),"right":b.iter().flat_map(|u|u.loc(r,"right")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),"defaultVisible":true})
+}
+fn value_like(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(
+            r"%|\d[.,]\d|\p{{Sc}}|\b(?:USD|EUR|GBP)\b|(?<!\p{{L}})(?:{CURRENCY})\s*\d|\d\s*(?:{CURRENCY})(?!\p{{L}})|\d{{1,2}}/\d{{1,2}}/\d{{2,4}}|\b\d{{4}}-\d{{1,2}}-\d{{1,2}}\b"
+        ),
+        t,
+    ) || test(
+        r"(?i)\b\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+(?:jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?,?\s+\d{4}\b",
+        t,
+    )
+}
+const ID: &str = r"MSN|ESN|S/N|serial|registration|(?:re)?insurer";
+fn identity_heading(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(r"(?i)\b(?:{ID})(?:\s*(?:no\.?|nr\.?|number|#))?$"),
+        trim(&nfkc(t)),
+    )
+}
+fn identity_name(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(r"(?i)^(?:{ID})(?:\s*(?:no\.?|nr\.?|number|#))?$"),
+        trim(&nfkc(t)),
+    )
+}
+fn names_identity(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().any(|c| identity_name(c))
+}
+fn names_column(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    u.cells
+        .as_ref()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .any(|c| identity_heading(c))
+}
+fn value_free(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    !u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().any(|c| {
+        let c = nfkc(c);
+        let t = re(&format!(r"[%‰\p{{Sc}}]|\b(?:{CURRENCY})\b"))
+            .replace_all(&c, |m: &fancy_regex::Captures| {
+                let g = m.get(0).unwrap();
+                if test(r"\p{N}\s*$", &c[..g.start()]) || test(r"^\s*[-−+]?\p{N}", &c[g.end()..])
+                {
+                    g.as_str().into()
+                } else {
+                    String::new()
+                }
+            })
+            .into_owned();
+        value_like(&t)
+    })
+}
+fn heading_like(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    !test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw) || (names_identity(u) && value_free(u))
+}
+fn cell_key(u: &Unit) -> String {
+    canonical(&json!(u.cells))
+}
+fn under(h: Option<&Unit>, [x0, x1]: [f64; 2]) -> Option<(usize, String)> {
+    let h = h?;
+    let overlaps: Vec<_> = h.spans.iter().map(|[a, b]| b.min(x1) - a.max(x0)).collect();
+    let max = overlaps.iter().copied().fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
+    let j = overlaps.iter().position(|x| *x == max)?;
+    if max > 0. {
+        Some((j, h.cells.as_ref().unwrap()[j].clone()))
+    } else {
+        None
+    }
+}
+struct Headings {
+    heads: Map<String, Unit>,
+    scopes: Map<String, String>,
+    starts: Set<String>,
+}
+impl Headings {
+    fn head(&self, u: &Unit) -> Option<&Unit> {
+        self.heads.get(&u.id)
+    }
+    fn scope(&self, u: &Unit) -> String {
+        self.scopes
+            .get(&u.id)
+            .cloned()
+            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}\0{}\0", u.section(), u.title))
+    }
+    fn slots(&self, u: &Unit) -> String {
+        let h = self.head(u);
+        canonical(&json!(
+            u.spans
+                .iter()
+                .enumerate()
+                .map(|(k, sp)| {
+                    let slot = under(h, *sp)
+                        .map(|(j, _)| format!("c{j}"))
+                        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
+                            format!(
+                                "g{}",
+                                h.map(|h| h.spans.iter().filter(|s| s[1] <= sp[0]).count())
+                                    .unwrap_or(0)
+                            )
+                        });
+                    json!([slot, u.cells.as_ref().unwrap()[k]])
+                })
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        ))
+    }
+}
+fn row_headings(left: &[Unit], right: &[Unit]) -> [Headings; 2] {
+    let mut output = [
+        Headings {
+            heads: Map::new(),
+            scopes: Map::new(),
+            starts: Set::new(),
+        },
+        Headings {
+            heads: Map::new(),
+            scopes: Map::new(),
+            starts: Set::new(),
+        },
+    ];
+    let mut sides = vec![];
+    for (side, us) in [left, right].iter().enumerate() {
+        let mut current: Map<String, Unit> = Map::new();
+        let mut open: Map<String, (String, String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        let mut last: Map<String, (String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        let mut broken = Set::new();
+        let mut closed = Map::new();
+        let mut page = Map::new();
+        let mut count: Map<String, usize> = Map::new();
+        let mut table: Map<String, (String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        for u in *us {
+            if u.ambiguous {
+                continue;
+            }
+            if u.cells.is_none() {
+                if !["furniture", "page_heading", "footer", "whitespace"].contains(&u.role.as_str())
+                {
+                    current.clear();
+                    open.clear();
+                    closed.clear()
+                }
+                if ![
+                    "furniture",
+                    "page_heading",
+                    "footer",
+                    "whitespace",
+                    "heading",
+                ]
+                .contains(&u.role.as_str())
+                {
+                    broken.extend(last.keys().cloned());
+                }
+                continue;
+            }
+            let t = format!("{}\0{}", u.section(), u.title);
+            let st = open.get(&t).cloned();
+            let p = u.page();
+            let before = page.insert(t.clone(), p);
+            let ck = cell_key(u);
+            let label = st.is_some()
+                && names_identity(u)
+                && u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().enumerate().any(|(k, c)| {
+                    identity_name(c)
+                        && !under(current.get(&t), u.spans[k])
+                            .map(|(_, t)| identity_heading(&t))
+                            .unwrap_or(false)
+                });
+            if (!test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw) || value_free(u))
+                && st.is_some()
+                && ck != st.as_ref().unwrap().0
+                && (label || (!names_identity(u) && names_column(u)))
+            {
+                current.shift_remove(&t);
+                open.shift_remove(&t);
+                broken.insert(t.clone());
+                let key = format!("{t}\0{ck}");
+                let n = count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;
+                count.insert(key.clone(), n);
+                closed.insert(t.clone(), (key.clone(), n));
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (key, n));
+                continue;
+            }
+            if !test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw)
+                && st.is_some()
+                && ck != st.as_ref().unwrap().0
+                && !names_identity(u)
+            {
+                output[side].heads.insert(u.id.clone(), current[&t].clone());
+                let st = st.unwrap();
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (st.1, st.2));
+            } else if heading_like(u) {
+                let prev = last.get(&t);
+                let key = format!("{t}\0{ck}");
+                let n = if prev
+                    .map(|v| {
+                        v.0 == ck && !broken.contains(&t) && before.map(|b| p > b).unwrap_or(false)
+                    })
+                    .unwrap_or(false)
+                {
+                    prev.unwrap().1
+                } else {
+                    count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0) + 1
+                };
+                count.insert(key.clone(), n.max(*count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0)));
+                last.insert(t.clone(), (ck.clone(), n));
+                broken.shift_remove(&t);
+                current.insert(t.clone(), u.clone());
+                open.insert(t.clone(), (ck, key.clone(), n));
+                closed.shift_remove(&t);
+                output[side].starts.insert(u.id.clone());
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (key, n));
+            } else if let Some(h) = current.get(&t) {
+                output[side].heads.insert(u.id.clone(), h.clone());
+                table.insert(
+                    u.id.clone(),
+                    (format!("{t}\0{}", cell_key(h)), st.unwrap().2),
+                );
+            } else if let Some(c) = closed.get(&t) {
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), c.clone());
+            }
+        }
+        sides.push((count, table));
+    }
+    for side in 0..2 {
+        for (id, (key, n)) in &sides[side].1 {
+            let scope = if sides.iter().all(|x| x.0.get(key) == Some(&1)) {
+                key.clone()
+            } else {
+                format!("{key}\0{side}\0{n}")
+            };
+            output[side].scopes.insert(id.clone(), scope);
+        }
+    }
+    output
+}
+fn identity_cells(r: &Unit, head: &Headings) -> Map<String, String> {
+    let h = head.head(r);
+    let mut cells = vec![];
+    for (k, c0) in r.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
+        let c = nfkc(c0);
+        let at = under(h, r.spans[k]);
+        let named = re(&format!(r"(?i)^(?:{ID})\b"))
+            .find(&c)
+            .ok()
+            .flatten()
+            .map(|m| m.as_str().to_lowercase())
+            .map(|n| if n == "s/n" { "serial".into() } else { n });
+        if let Some((j, t)) = &at {
+            if identity_heading(t) {
+                cells.push((format!("column {j}"), c));
+                continue;
+            }
+        }
+        if at.is_some()
+            || named.is_none()
+            || identity_name(&replace(r"[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$", trim(&c), ""))
+        {
+            continue;
+        }
+        cells.push((format!("named {}", named.unwrap()), c));
+    }
+    let crowded = cells
+        .iter()
+        .any(|(k, _)| cells.iter().filter(|(x, _)| x == k).count() > 1);
+    let mut m: Map<_, _> = cells
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(k, _)| cells.iter().filter(|(x, _)| x == k).count() == 1)
+        .cloned()
+        .collect();
+    let missing: Vec<_> = h
+        .map(|h| {
+            h.cells
+                .as_ref()
+                .unwrap()
+                .iter()
+                .enumerate()
+                .filter(|(j, t)| identity_heading(t) && !m.contains_key(&format!("column {j}")))
+                .map(|(j, _)| j)
+                .collect()
+        })
+        .unwrap_or_default();
+    let columns: Vec<_> = r
+        .spans
+        .iter()
+        .map(|sp| under(h, *sp).map(|(j, _)| j))
+        .collect();
+    let open = columns.iter().enumerate().any(|(k, j)| {
+        let Some(j) = j else { return true };
+        if columns.iter().filter(|x| *x == &Some(*j)).count() > 1 {
+            return true;
+        }
+        let [x0, x1] = r.spans[k];
+        let [h0, h1] = h.unwrap().spans[*j];
+        missing
+            .iter()
+            .any(|e| if e < j { x0 < h0 - 1. } else { x1 > h1 + 1. })
+    });
+    if crowded || (!missing.is_empty() && open) {
+        m.insert("incomplete".into(), String::new());
+    }
+    m
+}
+fn table_pairs(
+    la: &[Unit],
+    rb: &[Unit],
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    un: &mut Vec<V>,
+    l: &Doc,
+    r: &Doc,
+) {
+    let rows = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        group(us, &Set::new(), |u| {
+            if u.role == "cell" {
+                u.table_row.clone()
+            } else {
+                None
+            }
+        })
+        .into_values()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+    };
+    let a = rows(la);
+    let b = rows(rb);
+    let mut da = Set::new();
+    let mut db = Set::new();
+    let unique = |rs: &Vec<Vec<Unit>>, primary: bool, v: &Option<String>| {
+        rs.iter()
+            .enumerate()
+            .filter(|(_, r)| {
+                v.is_some()
+                    && if primary {
+                        r[0].primary == *v
+                    } else {
+                        r[0].secondary == *v
+                    }
+            })
+            .map(|(i, _)| i)
+            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+    };
+    for (i, row) in a.iter().enumerate() {
+        let p = unique(&b, true, &row[0].primary);
+        let s = unique(&b, false, &row[0].secondary);
+        let op = unique(&a, true, &row[0].primary);
+        let os = unique(&a, false, &row[0].secondary);
+        if p.len() == 1 && s.len() == 1 && p[0] != s[0] {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let other = if op.len() == 1 && p.len() == 1 {
+            Some(p[0])
+        } else if os.len() == 1 && s.len() == 1 {
+            Some(s[0])
+        } else {
+            None
+        };
+        let Some(j) = other else { continue };
+        if db.contains(&j) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        da.insert(i);
+        db.insert(j);
+        for u in row {
+            if let Some(v) = b[j].iter().find(|v| v.path["field"] == u.path["field"]) {
+                let (mut u, mut v) = (u.clone(), v.clone());
+                u.path["confidence"] = json!("reliable");
+                v.path["confidence"] = json!("reliable");
+                bind(pairs, ul, ur, u, v, "declared-table-key", None);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let ra: Vec<_> = a
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .filter(|(i, _)| !da.contains(i))
+        .flat_map(|(_, r)| r.clone())
+        .collect();
+    let br: Vec<_> = b
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .filter(|(i, _)| !db.contains(i))
+        .flat_map(|(_, r)| r.clone())
+        .collect();
+    let duplicate = a.iter().enumerate().any(|(i, row)| {
+        !da.contains(&i)
+            && (unique(&a, true, &row[0].primary).len() > 1
+                || unique(&a, false, &row[0].secondary).len() > 1)
+    }) || b.iter().enumerate().any(|(i, row)| {
+        !db.contains(&i)
+            && (unique(&b, true, &row[0].primary).len() > 1
+                || unique(&b, false, &row[0].secondary).len() > 1)
+    });
+    if !ra.is_empty() && !br.is_empty() {
+        let fields: Set<_> = ra.iter().map(|u| s(&u.path["field"]).to_string()).collect();
+        for f in fields {
+            let aa: Vec<_> = ra
+                .iter()
+                .filter(|u| u.path["field"] == f)
+                .cloned()
+                .collect();
+            let bb: Vec<_> = br
+                .iter()
+                .filter(|u| u.path["field"] == f)
+                .cloned()
+                .collect();
+            if aa.is_empty() || bb.is_empty() {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let x = aggregate(&aa, format!("ambiguous-left-{f}"), true);
+            let y = aggregate(&bb, format!("ambiguous-right-{f}"), true);
+            mark(ul, &aa);
+            mark(ur, &bb);
+            un.push(unresolved(
+                "ambiguous_identity",
+                if duplicate {
+                    "表格主键或次级键重复；金额变化仍展示，无法确定唯一实体"
+                } else {
+                    "表格主次键冲突或缺少可靠对应"
+                },
+                &[x.clone()],
+                &[y.clone()],
+                l,
+                r,
+            ));
+            bind(pairs, ul, ur, x, y, "unresolved-table-group", None);
+        }
+    }
+}
+fn row_identity(
+    la: &[Unit],
+    rb: &[Unit],
+    heads: &[Headings; 2],
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    un: &mut Vec<V>,
+    l: &Doc,
+    r: &Doc,
+) {
+    let owners = |rows: &Vec<Unit>, h: &Headings| {
+        let mut m: Map<String, Vec<Unit>> = Map::new();
+        for row in rows {
+            let ids = identity_cells(row, h);
+            if row.ambiguous || ids.contains_key("incomplete") {
+                continue;
+            }
+            for (k, c) in ids {
+                if !value_like(&c) {
+                    m.entry(format!("{k}\0{c}")).or_default().push(row.clone())
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        m
+    };
+    let tables = |us: &[Unit], h: &Headings| {
+        group(us, &Set::new(), |u| u.cells.as_ref().map(|_| h.scope(u)))
+    };
+    let lt = tables(la, &heads[0]);
+    let rt = tables(rb, &heads[1]);
+    let mut links: Map<(usize, String), Set<(usize, String)>> = Map::new();
+    let mut via: Map<String, String> = Map::new();
+    for (t, rows) in lt {
+        let Some(other) = rt.get(&t) else { continue };
+        let ro = owners(other, &heads[1]);
+        for (key, aa) in owners(&rows, &heads[0]) {
+            let Some(bb) = ro.get(&key) else { continue };
+            if aa.len() != 1 || bb.len() != 1 {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let (a, b) = (&aa[0], &bb[0]);
+            if ul.contains(&a.id) || ur.contains(&b.id) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            links
+                .entry((0, a.id.clone()))
+                .or_default()
+                .insert((1, b.id.clone()));
+            links
+                .entry((1, b.id.clone()))
+                .or_default()
+                .insert((0, a.id.clone()));
+            via.entry(a.id.clone())
+                .or_insert_with(|| key.split('\0').nth(1).unwrap_or("").into());
+        }
+    }
+    let mut seen = Set::new();
+    for start in la {
+        let start = (0, start.id.clone());
+        if !links.contains_key(&start) || seen.contains(&start) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let mut g = vec![];
+        let mut queue = vec![start];
+        while let Some(u) = queue.pop() {
+            if !seen.insert(u.clone()) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            g.push(u.clone());
+            queue.extend(links.get(&u).unwrap().iter().cloned());
+        }
+        let mut aa: Vec<_> = g
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(s, _)| *s == 0)
+            .map(|(_, id)| la.iter().find(|u| u.id == *id).unwrap().clone())
+            .collect();
+        let mut bb: Vec<_> = g
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(s, _)| *s == 1)
+            .map(|(_, id)| rb.iter().find(|u| u.id == *id).unwrap().clone())
+            .collect();
+        aa.sort_by_key(|u| u.order);
+        bb.sort_by_key(|u| u.order);
+        if aa.len() == 1 && bb.len() == 1 {
+            let x = identity_cells(&aa[0], &heads[0]);
+            let y = identity_cells(&bb[0], &heads[1]);
+            if x.iter()
+                .all(|(k, c)| y.get(k).map(|v| v == c).unwrap_or(true))
+            {
+                let key = via.get(&aa[0].id).cloned();
+                aa[0].path["rowKey"] = json!(key);
+                bb[0].path["rowKey"] = json!(key);
+                bind(
+                    pairs,
+                    ul,
+                    ur,
+                    aa[0].clone(),
+                    bb[0].clone(),
+                    "row-identity",
+                    None,
+                );
+                continue;
+            }
+        }
+        let x = aggregate(&aa, format!("row-conflict-left-{}", aa[0].id), true);
+        let y = aggregate(&bb, format!("row-conflict-right-{}", bb[0].id), true);
+        mark(ul, &aa);
+        mark(ur, &bb);
+        un.push(unresolved("ambiguous_identity","表格行的身份证据互相冲突（例如两个身份列指向不同行，或同一身份列的值不同）；未自动配对，组内原文变化仍展示",&[x.clone()],&[y.clone()],l,r));
+        bind(pairs, ul, ur, x, y, "unresolved-row-identity", None);
+    }
+}
+fn repeated(us: &[Unit], id: String) -> Unit {
+    let mut u = aggregate(us, id, false);
+    u.m = normalize(&us[0].m.raw, us[0].m.refs.clone());
+    u.repeats = Some(us.to_vec());
+    u
+}
+fn page_list(us: &[Unit]) -> String {
+    us.iter()
+        .map(|u| (u.page() + 1).to_string())
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join("、")
+}
+fn compare_repeated(
+    as_: &[Unit],
+    bs: &[Unit],
+    method: &str,
+    prefix: &str,
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    singles: &mut Vec<(Option<Unit>, Option<Unit>)>,
+) {
+    let texts = |us: &[Unit]| group(us, &Set::new(), |u| Some(variant(u)));
+    let l = texts(as_);
+    let r = texts(bs);
+    if l.len() == 1 && r.len() == 1 {
+        let shown = |us: &[Unit], other: &str, id: String| {
+            let i = if l.keys().next() == r.keys().next() {
+                None
+            } else {
+                us.iter().position(|u| u.m.raw != other)
+            };
+            let mut order = us.to_vec();
+            if let Some(i) = i {
+                if i > 0 {
+                    let u = order.remove(i);
+                    order.insert(0, u)
+                }
+            }
+            let mut u = repeated(&order, id);
+            u.repeats = Some(us.to_vec());
+            u
+        };
+        let b = shown(bs, &as_[0].m.raw, format!("{prefix}-right-{}", bs[0].id));
+        let a = shown(as_, &b.m.raw, format!("{prefix}-left-{}", as_[0].id));
+        bind(pairs, ul, ur, a, b, method, None);
+        return;
+    }
+    let quote = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        format!(
+            "“{}”{}",
+            trim(&us[0].m.raw),
+            if us.iter().map(|u| trim(&u.m.raw)).collect::<Set<_>>().len() > 1 {
+                "等（页码随所在页）"
+            } else {
+                ""
+            }
+        )
+    };
+    for (own, other, is_right) in [(&r, &l, true), (&l, &r, false)] {
+        let (name, other_name) = if is_right {
+            ("待审版", "基准版")
+        } else {
+            ("基准版", "待审版")
+        };
+        let unchanged: Vec<_> = own
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(t, _)| other.contains_key(*t))
+            .flat_map(|(_, us)| us.clone())
+            .collect();
+        for (text, us) in own {
+            if other.contains_key(text) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let kept = if other.len() == 1 {
+                other.values().next()
+            } else {
+                None
+            };
+            if kept.is_none() && own.len() == 1 {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let mut note = format!(
+                "本版组内文字不一致：{name}第 {} 页为{}文字",
+                page_list(us),
+                if is_right { "新" } else { "旧" }
+            );
+            if let Some(kept) = kept {
+                if !unchanged.is_empty() {
+                    note += &format!(
+                        "；{name}第 {} 页仍为{other_name}文字{}",
+                        page_list(&unchanged),
+                        quote(kept)
+                    );
+                }
+            } else {
+                note += &format!("，{other_name}没有相同文字")
+            };
+            let mut card = repeated(
+                us,
+                format!(
+                    "{prefix}-{}-{}",
+                    if is_right { "right" } else { "left" },
+                    us[0].id
+                ),
+            );
+            card.others = unchanged.clone();
+            card.separate = true;
+            card.note = note;
+            if let Some(kept) = kept {
+                let whole = repeated(
+                    kept,
+                    format!(
+                        "{prefix}-{}-{}",
+                        if is_right { "left" } else { "right" },
+                        kept[0].id
+                    ),
+                );
+                if is_right {
+                    bind(pairs, ul, ur, whole, card, method, None)
+                } else {
+                    bind(pairs, ul, ur, card, whole, method, None)
+                }
+            } else {
+                singles.push(if is_right {
+                    (None, Some(card))
+                } else {
+                    (Some(card), None)
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let one_sided = |own: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>, other: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>| {
+        own.keys().any(|t| !other.contains_key(t))
+    };
+    if (l.len() == 1 && one_sided(&r, &l)) || (r.len() == 1 && one_sided(&l, &r)) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (text, ls) in &l {
+        let Some(rs) = r.get(text) else { continue };
+        if rs.len() == ls.len() {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let others = |m: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>| {
+            m.iter()
+                .filter(|(t, _)| *t != text)
+                .flat_map(|(_, us)| us.clone())
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        };
+        let lo = others(&l);
+        let ro = others(&r);
+        let mut note = "同一行的其他写法只作上下文，不计入本写法的次数".to_string();
+        if !lo.is_empty() {
+            note += &format!("：基准版第 {} 页", page_list(&lo))
+        }
+        if !ro.is_empty() {
+            note += &format!(
+                "{}待审版第 {} 页",
+                if lo.is_empty() { "：" } else { "；" },
+                page_list(&ro)
+            )
+        }
+        let mut a = repeated(ls, format!("{prefix}-left-{}", ls[0].id));
+        a.others = lo;
+        a.separate = true;
+        a.note = note;
+        let mut b = repeated(rs, format!("{prefix}-right-{}", rs[0].id));
+        b.others = ro;
+        b.separate = true;
+        bind(pairs, ul, ur, a, b, method, None);
+    }
+}
+struct Scoring<'a> {
+    budget: &'a V,
+    candidates: usize,
+    products: u64,
+    exhausted: bool,
+}
+impl Scoring<'_> {
+    fn score(&mut self, a: &Unit, b: &Unit, threshold: f64) -> Option<f64> {
+        let at = tokenize(&a.m.text);
+        let bt = tokenize(&b.m.text);
+        let denom = (at.len() + bt.len()) as f64;
+        if at.is_empty() || bt.is_empty() || 2. * at.len().min(bt.len()) as f64 / denom < threshold
+        {
+            return None;
+        }
+        let counts = |ts: &Vec<String>| {
+            let mut m: Map<String, usize> = Map::new();
+            for t in ts {
+                *m.entry(t.clone()).or_default() += 1
+            }
+            m
+        };
+        let ac = counts(&at);
+        let bc = counts(&bt);
+        let intersection: usize = ac
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(t, n)| (*n).min(*bc.get(t).unwrap_or(&0)))
+            .sum();
+        if 2. * intersection as f64 / denom < threshold {
+            return None;
+        }
+        if self.candidates as f64 >= n(&self.budget["candidates"])
+            || (self
+                .products
+                .saturating_add(work_product(at.len(), bt.len()))) as f64
+                > n(&self.budget["tokenProducts"])
+        {
+            self.exhausted = true;
+            return None;
+        }
+        self.candidates += 1;
+        self.products += work_product(at.len(), bt.len());
+        let v = 2. * lcs_length(&at, &bt) as f64 / denom;
+        if v >= threshold { Some(v) } else { None }
+    }
+}
+fn joint_align(
+    as_: &[Unit],
+    bs: &[Unit],
+    heads: &[Headings; 2],
+    sc: &mut Scoring,
+    threshold: f64,
+) -> Vec<(Vec<Unit>, Vec<Unit>, f64)> {
+    let _ = heads;
+    let w = bs.len() + 1;
+    let mut cost = vec![f64::INFINITY; (as_.len() + 1) * w];
+    let mut prev = vec![0; cost.len()];
+    let mut values = Map::new();
+    cost[0] = 0.;
+    let choices = [(1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1), (1, 0), (0, 1)];
+    let can_join = |a: &Unit, b: &Unit| {
+        a.order + 1 == b.order
+            && a.cells.is_none()
+            && b.cells.is_none()
+            && a.title == b.title
+            && a.section() == b.section()
+    };
+    let get = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        if us.len() == 1 {
+            us[0].clone()
+        } else {
+            aggregate(
+                us,
+                us.iter()
+                    .map(|u| {
+                        u.m.refs
+                            .iter()
+                            .flatten()
+                            .next()
+                            .map(|r| format!("{}:{}:{}", r.p, r.c, r.l))
+                            .unwrap_or(u.id.clone())
+                    })
+                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                    .join("+"),
+                false,
+            )
+        }
+    };
+    for i in 0..=as_.len() {
+        for j in 0..=bs.len() {
+            crate::checkpoint();
+            for (c, (di, dj)) in choices.iter().copied().enumerate() {
+                if i + di > as_.len()
+                    || j + dj > bs.len()
+                    || (di == 2 && !can_join(&as_[i], &as_[i + 1]))
+                    || (dj == 2 && !can_join(&bs[j], &bs[j + 1]))
+                {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                let value = if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+                    let aa = &as_[i..i + di];
+                    let bb = &bs[j..j + dj];
+                    if aa.iter().chain(bb).any(|u| u.cells.is_some()) {
+                        None
+                    } else {
+                        let a = get(aa);
+                        let b = get(bb);
+                        if a.title != b.title
+                            || a.section() != b.section()
+                            || as_
+                                .iter()
+                                .filter(|u| u.m.raw == a.m.raw && u.title == a.title)
+                                .count()
+                                > 1
+                            || bs
+                                .iter()
+                                .filter(|u| u.m.raw == b.m.raw && u.title == b.title)
+                                .count()
+                                > 1
+                        {
+                            None
+                        } else {
+                            sc.score(&a, &b, threshold)
+                        }
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    None
+                };
+                if di > 0 && dj > 0 && value.is_none() {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                let next = (i + di) * w + j + dj;
+                let v = cost[i * w + j]
+                    + if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+                        1. - value.unwrap() + 0.03 * (di + dj - 2) as f64
+                    } else {
+                        1.
+                    };
+                if v < cost[next] - 1e-12 {
+                    cost[next] = v;
+                    prev[next] = c + 1;
+                    if let Some(v) = value {
+                        values.insert(next, v);
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let (mut i, mut j) = (as_.len(), bs.len());
+    let mut out = vec![];
+    while i > 0 || j > 0 {
+        let c = prev[i * w + j];
+        if c == 0 {
+            break;
+        }
+        let (di, dj) = choices[c - 1];
+        if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+            out.push((
+                as_[i - di..i].to_vec(),
+                bs[j - dj..j].to_vec(),
+                values[&(i * w + j)],
+            ));
+        }
+        i -= di;
+        j -= dj;
+    }
+    out.reverse();
+    out
+}
+pub fn compare(l: &Doc, r: &Doc, p: &V, budget: &V) -> Result<V, String> {

+        .into_iter()
+        .filter(|u| u.role != "logical_separator")
+        .collect();
+    let rb: Vec<_> = structure(r, p, &shared)?
+        .into_iter()
+        .filter(|u| u.role != "logical_separator")
+        .collect();

+    let mut un = vec![];
+    let mut layout = [Set::new(), Set::new()];
+    let titled = |u: &&Unit| u.role == "page_heading" || u.role == "heading";
+    let tl: Set<_> = la.iter().filter(titled).map(|u| trim(&u.m.raw)).collect();
+    let tr: Set<_> = rb.iter().filter(titled).map(|u| trim(&u.m.raw)).collect();
+    for (side, us) in [&la, &rb].iter().enumerate() {
+        for u in us.iter().filter(titled) {
+            if let Some(m) = re(r"(?i)^(.+?)[\s(,:–-]*\b(?:continued|cont['’]d|cont\.?)\)?\.?$")
+                .captures(trim(&u.m.raw))
+                .ok()
+                .flatten()
+            {
+                let base = trim(m.get(1).unwrap().as_str());

+    let uncertain_r: Vec<_> = rb.iter().filter(|u| u.ambiguous).cloned().collect();
+    for (us, side) in [(&uncertain_l, 0), (&uncertain_r, 1)] {
+        for u in us {
+            if side == 0 {
+                ul.insert(u.id.clone());
+            } else {
+                ur.insert(u.id.clone());
+            }
+            un.push(unresolved("ambiguous_identity","这些完整基线可能是多条记录，也可能是每格折行的一条记录；局部结构与身份未确定，原文分别保留",if side==0{std::slice::from_ref(u)}else{&[]},if side==1{std::slice::from_ref(u)}else{&[]},l,r));
+        }
+    }
+    table_pairs(&la, &rb, &mut pairs, &mut ul, &mut ur, &mut un, l, r);
+    let il = group(&la, &ul, |u| u.identity.clone());
+    let ir = group(&rb, &ur, |u| u.identity.clone());
+    let mut declared = vec![];
+    for (key, as_) in il {
+        crate::checkpoint();
+        let Some(bs) = ir.get(&key) else { continue };
+        if as_.len() == 1 && bs.len() == 1 {
+            bind(
+                &mut pairs,
+                &mut ul,
+                &mut ur,
+                as_[0].clone(),
+                bs[0].clone(),
+                "reliable-field-identity",
+                None,
+            )
+        } else if as_
+            .iter()
+            .chain(bs)
+            .all(|u| u.path["section"] == "repeated_header" || u.role == "table_header")
+        {
+            declared.push((as_.clone(), bs.clone()));
+            mark(&mut ul, &as_);
+            mark(&mut ur, bs);
+        } else if as_
+            .iter()
+            .chain(bs)
+            .all(|u| u.role == "field" || u.role == "label")
+        {
+            let titles: Set<_> = as_
+                .iter()
+                .map(|u| u.title.clone())
+                .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
+                .collect();
+            for title in titles {
+                let aa: Vec<_> = as_.iter().filter(|u| u.title == title).cloned().collect();
+                let bb: Vec<_> = bs.iter().filter(|u| u.title == title).cloned().collect();
+                if aa.len() == 1 && bb.len() == 1 {
+                    let mut a = aa[0].clone();
+                    let mut b = bb[0].clone();
+                    for u in [&mut a, &mut b] {
+                        if u.section() != title {
+                            u.path["section"] = json!(if u.section() == "risk_details" {
+                                title.clone()
+                            } else {
+                                format!("{} / {title}", u.section())
+                            });
+                        }
+                        u.identity = Some(format!(
+                            "{}/{}/{}",
+                            u.section(),
+                            s(&u.path["entity"]),
+                            s(&u.path["field"])

+                    }
+                    bind(
+                        &mut pairs,
+                        &mut ul,

+fn emit(
+    a: Option<&Unit>,
+    b: Option<&Unit>,
+    method: &str,
+    score: Option<f64>,
+    moved: bool,
+    l: &Doc,
+    r: &Doc,
+    budget: &V,
+    layout: &[Set<String>; 2],
+    heads: &[Headings; 2],
+    diffs: &mut Vec<V>,
+    un: &mut Vec<V>,
+) {
+    let ar = a.and_then(|u| u.repeats.as_ref());
+    let br = b.and_then(|u| u.repeats.as_ref());
+    let recount = ar.is_some() && br.is_some() && ar.unwrap().len() != br.unwrap().len();
+    if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (a, b) {
+        if a.m.raw == b.m.raw && !moved && !recount {
+            if a.cells.is_some() && b.cells.is_some() && heads[0].slots(a) != heads[1].slots(b) {
+                un.push(unresolved(
+                    "ambiguous_match",
+                    "两版本这一表格行的原文相同，但各格的划分不同；哪个值在哪一列未能确定",
+                    &[a.clone()],
+                    &[b.clone()],
+                    l,
+                    r,
+                ));
+            }
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+    let kind = if moved {
+        "Moved"
+    } else if a.is_some() && b.is_some() {
+        "Replaced"
+    } else if a.is_some() {
+        "Removed"
+    } else {
+        "Added"
+    };
+    let u = a.or(b).unwrap();
+    let old = a.map(|u| u.m.raw.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
+    let now = b.map(|u| u.m.raw.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
+    let left = a.map(|u| u.loc(l, "left")).unwrap_or_default();
+    let right = b.map(|u| u.loc(r, "right")).unwrap_or_default();
+    let ops = text_ops(a, b, l, r, budget, un);
+    let mut occ = vec![];
+    if a.map(|u| u.separate).unwrap_or(false) || b.map(|u| u.separate).unwrap_or(false) {
+        for (side, u, d) in [("left", a, l), ("right", b, r)] {
+            if let Some(u) = u {
+                for g in u.repeats.iter().flatten() {
+                    let mut v = json!({"left":[],"right":[]});
+                    v[side] = json!(g.loc(d, side));
+                    occ.push(v)
+                }
+                for g in &u.others {
+                    let mut v = json!({"left":[],"right":[],"context":true});
+                    v[side] = json!(g.loc(d, side));
+                    occ.push(v)
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    } else if ar.is_some() || br.is_some() {
+        for i in 0..ar
+            .map(Vec::len)
+            .unwrap_or(0)
+            .max(br.map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(0))
+        {
+            occ.push(json!({"left":ar.and_then(|us|us.get(i)).map(|u|u.loc(l,"left")).unwrap_or_default(),"right":br.and_then(|us|us.get(i)).map(|u|u.loc(r,"right")).unwrap_or_default()}));
+        }
+    }
+    let repeat = if ar.is_some() || br.is_some() {
+        json!({"left":ar.map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(0),"right":br.map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(0),"leftPages":l.pages.len(),"rightPages":r.pages.len()})
+    } else {
+        V::Null
+    };
+    let reasons = if u.path["confidence"] == "unresolved" {
+        vec![if u.path["table"].is_string() {
+            "无法确定唯一表格行身份".to_string()
+        } else {
+            "无法确定同名字段的唯一归属".into()
+        }]
+    } else if ar.is_some() || br.is_some() {
+        let notes = a
+            .into_iter()
+            .chain(b)
+            .filter(|u| !u.note.is_empty())
+            .map(|u| format!("；{}", u.note))
+            .collect::<String>();
+        vec![format!(
+            "这段文字出现次数：{} 次 → {} 次；文档页数：{} 页 → {} 页{}；逐处来源见出现位置",
+            ar.map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(0),
+            br.map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(0),
+            l.pages.len(),
+            r.pages.len(),
+            notes
+        )]
+    } else {
+        vec![]
+    };
+    let id = format!(
+        "d-{}",
+        &digest(
+            &json!({"kind":kind,"old":old,"new":now,"left":left.iter().map(|x|x["charIds"].clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),"right":right.iter().map(|x|x["charIds"].clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>()})
+        )[..20]
+    );
+    diffs.push(json!({"id":id,"kind":kind,"structurePath":u.path,"left":left,"right":right,"oldText":old,"newText":now,"textOps":ops,"hasTextChange":old!=now,"facts":facts(a,b,layout),"repeat":repeat,"defaultVisible":true,"matchEvidence":{"method":method,"score":score,"details":[if method=="reliable-field-identity"{"主体与字段身份一致"}else{method}]},"reviewReasons":reasons,"occurrences":occ}));
+}

+use crate::{model::*, structure::*, text::*};
+use serde_json::json;
+#[derive(Clone)]
+struct Token {
+    start: usize,
+    end: usize,
+    text: String,
+}
+fn tokens(cs: &[char]) -> Vec<Token> {
+    let kind = |c: char| {
+        if test(r"\p{L}", &c.to_string()) {
+            'L'
+        } else if test(r"\p{N}", &c.to_string()) {
+            'N'
+        } else if ws(c) {
+            'S'
+        } else {
+            'P'
+        }
+    };
+    let mut out = vec![];
+    let mut k = 0;
+    while k < cs.len() {
+        let t = kind(cs[k]);
+        let mut e = k + 1;
+        if t != 'P' {
+            while e < cs.len()
+                && (kind(cs[e]) == t
+                    || (t == 'N'
+                        && ['.', ','].contains(&cs[e])
+                        && e + 1 < cs.len()
+                        && kind(cs[e + 1]) == 'N'))
+            {
+                e += 1
+            }
+        }
+        out.push(Token {
+            start: k,
+            end: e,
+            text: cs[k..e].iter().collect(),
+        });
+        k = e
+    }
+    out
+}
+#[derive(Clone)]
+struct Op {
+    kind: u8,
+    i: usize,
+    j: usize,
+    text: char,
+}
+struct Script<'a> {
+    x: &'a [char],
+    y: &'a [char],
+    prefix: usize,
+    ops: Vec<Op>,
+}
+impl Script<'_> {
+    fn equal(&mut self, i: usize, j: usize) {
+        self.ops.push(Op {
+            kind: 0,
+            i: self.prefix + i,
+            j: self.prefix + j,
+            text: self.x[i],
+        });
+    }
+    fn replaced(&mut self, i0: usize, i1: usize, j0: usize, j1: usize) {
+        for i in i0..i1 {
+            self.ops.push(Op {
+                kind: 1,
+                i: self.prefix + i,
+                j: self.prefix + j0,
+                text: self.x[i],
+            })
+        }
+        for j in j0..j1 {
+            self.ops.push(Op {
+                kind: 2,
+                i: self.prefix + i1,
+                j: self.prefix + j,
+                text: self.y[j],
+            })
+        }
+    }
+    fn chars(&mut self, mut i0: usize, i1: usize, mut j0: usize, j1: usize, spaces: bool) {
+        let same = |i, j| self.x[i] == self.y[j] && (!spaces || ws(self.x[i]));
+        let mut e = 0;
+        while i0 + e < i1 && j0 + e < j1 && same(i0 + e, j0 + e) {
+            e += 1
+        }
+        for k in 0..e {
+            self.equal(i0 + k, j0 + k)
+        }
+        i0 += e;
+        j0 += e;
+        let mut f = 0;
+        while i1 - f > i0
+            && j1 - f > j0
+            && self.x[i1 - 1 - f] == self.y[j1 - 1 - f]
+            && (!spaces || ws(self.x[i1 - 1 - f]))
+        {
+            f += 1
+        }
+        self.replaced(i0, i1 - f, j0, j1 - f);
+        for k in (1..=f).rev() {
+            self.equal(i1 - k, j1 - k)
+        }
+    }
+    fn stretch(
+        &mut self,
+        xc: &[Token],
+        yc: &[Token],
+        a0: usize,
+        a1: usize,
+        b0: usize,
+        b1: usize,
+        mut i0: usize,
+        i1: usize,
+        mut j0: usize,
+        j1: usize,
+    ) {
+        if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0 {
+            self.chars(i0, i1, j0, j1, true);
+            return;
+        }
+        for k in 0..a1 - a0 {
+            let (u, v) = (&xc[a0 + k], &yc[b0 + k]);
+            self.chars(i0, u.start, j0, v.start, false);
+            self.chars(u.start, u.end, v.start, v.end, false);
+            i0 = u.end;
+            j0 = v.end
+        }
+        self.chars(i0, i1, j0, j1, false)
+    }

+pub fn text_ops(

+    b: Option<&Unit>,

+    }
+    let mut s = 0;

+        && s < bt.len() - p
+        && at[at.len() - 1 - s].text == bt[bt.len() - 1 - s].text

+        s += 1
+    }
+    let prefix = if p > 0 { at[p - 1].end } else { 0 };
+    let suffix = if s > 0 {
+        aa.len() - at[at.len() - s].start
+    } else {
+        0
+    };
+    let x = &aa[prefix..aa.len() - suffix];
+    let y = &bb[prefix..bb.len() - suffix];
+    let mut script = Script {
+        x,
+        y,
+        prefix,
+        ops: (0..prefix)
+            .map(|i| Op {

+                i,
+                j: i,
+                text: aa[i],
+            })
+            .collect(),
+    };
+    let shift = |t: &Token| Token {

+        end: t.end - prefix,
+        text: t.text.clone(),
+    };
+    let xc: Vec<_> = at[p..at.len() - s]

+        .iter()
+        .filter(|t| !t.text.chars().next().map(ws).unwrap_or(false))

+        .collect();
+    if work_product(xc.len(), yc.len()) as f64 > n(&budget["diffProducts"]) {
+        unresolved.push(json!({"reason":"word_diff_budget","message":"词级差异工作量超过上限；保留双方完整原文，定位降级","left":a.map(|u|u.loc(l,"left")).unwrap_or_default(),"right":b.map(|u|u.loc(r,"right")).unwrap_or_default(),"defaultVisible":true}));

+            &xc,
+            &yc,
+            ta,

+            tb,
+            yc.len(),
+            ci,
+            x.len(),
+            cj,
+            y.len(),

+    }
+    for k in (1..=suffix).rev() {
+        script.ops.push(Op {
+            kind: 0,
+            i: aa.len() - k,
+            j: bb.len() - k,
+            text: aa[aa.len() - k],
+        })
+    }
+    let mut groups: Vec<Vec<Op>> = vec![];
+    for op in script.ops {

+            groups.last_mut().unwrap().push(op)
+        } else {
+            groups.push(vec![op])
+        }
+    }
+    groups.iter().map(|g|json!({"kind":(["equal","delete","insert"][g[0].kind as usize]),"text":g.iter().map(|o|o.text).collect::<String>(),"left":a.filter(|_|g[0].kind!=2).map(|u|locations(&g.iter().map(|o|u.m.refs.get(o.i).copied().flatten()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),l,"left",&u.id)).unwrap_or_default(),"right":b.filter(|_|g[0].kind!=1).map(|u|locations(&g.iter().map(|o|u.m.refs.get(o.j).copied().flatten()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),r,"right",&u.id)).unwrap_or_default()})).collect()
+}

+use crate::{edits::*, model::*, structure::*, text::*};

+struct Pair {

+    b: Unit,

+fn bind(
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    a: Unit,
+    b: Unit,
+    method: &str,
+    score: Option<f64>,
+) {
+    ul.insert(a.id.clone());
+    ur.insert(b.id.clone());
+    pairs.push(Pair {
+        a,
+        b,

+fn group(
+    us: &[Unit],
+    used: &Set<String>,
+    key: impl Fn(&Unit) -> Option<String>,
+) -> Map<String, Vec<Unit>> {
+    let mut m: Map<String, Vec<Unit>> = Map::new();
+    for u in us {
+        if used.contains(&u.id) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if let Some(k) = key(u) {
+            m.entry(k).or_default().push(u.clone())
+        }
+    }
+    m
+}
+fn mark(used: &mut Set<String>, us: &[Unit]) {
+    used.extend(us.iter().map(|u| u.id.clone()));
+}
+fn unresolved(reason: &str, message: &str, a: &[Unit], b: &[Unit], l: &Doc, r: &Doc) -> V {
+    json!({"reason":reason,"message":message,"left":a.iter().flat_map(|u|u.loc(l,"left")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),"right":b.iter().flat_map(|u|u.loc(r,"right")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),"defaultVisible":true})

+fn value_like(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(
+            r"%|\d[.,]\d|\p{{Sc}}|\b(?:USD|EUR|GBP)\b|(?<!\p{{L}})(?:{CURRENCY})\s*\d|\d\s*(?:{CURRENCY})(?!\p{{L}})|\d{{1,2}}/\d{{1,2}}/\d{{2,4}}|\b\d{{4}}-\d{{1,2}}-\d{{1,2}}\b"
+        ),
+        t,
+    ) || test(
+        r"(?i)\b\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+(?:jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\.?,?\s+\d{4}\b",
+        t,
+    )
+}
+const ID: &str = r"MSN|ESN|S/N|serial|registration|(?:re)?insurer";
+fn identity_heading(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(r"(?i)\b(?:{ID})(?:\s*(?:no\.?|nr\.?|number|#))?$"),
+        trim(&nfkc(t)),
+    )
+}
+fn identity_name(t: &str) -> bool {
+    test(
+        &format!(r"(?i)^(?:{ID})(?:\s*(?:no\.?|nr\.?|number|#))?$"),
+        trim(&nfkc(t)),
+    )
+}
+fn names_identity(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().any(|c| identity_name(c))
+}
+fn names_column(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    u.cells
+        .as_ref()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .any(|c| identity_heading(c))
+}
+fn value_free(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    !u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().any(|c| {
+        let c = nfkc(c);
+        let t = re(&format!(r"[%‰\p{{Sc}}]|\b(?:{CURRENCY})\b"))
+            .replace_all(&c, |m: &fancy_regex::Captures| {
+                let g = m.get(0).unwrap();
+                if test(r"\p{N}\s*$", &c[..g.start()]) || test(r"^\s*[-−+]?\p{N}", &c[g.end()..])
+                {
+                    g.as_str().into()
+                } else {
+                    String::new()
+                }
+            })
+            .into_owned();
+        value_like(&t)
+    })
+}
+fn heading_like(u: &Unit) -> bool {
+    !test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw) || (names_identity(u) && value_free(u))
+}
+fn cell_key(u: &Unit) -> String {
+    canonical(&json!(u.cells))
+}
+fn under(h: Option<&Unit>, [x0, x1]: [f64; 2]) -> Option<(usize, String)> {
+    let h = h?;
+    let overlaps: Vec<_> = h.spans.iter().map(|[a, b]| b.min(x1) - a.max(x0)).collect();
+    let max = overlaps.iter().copied().fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
+    let j = overlaps.iter().position(|x| *x == max)?;
+    if max > 0. {
+        Some((j, h.cells.as_ref().unwrap()[j].clone()))
+    } else {
+        None
+    }
+}
+struct Headings {
+    heads: Map<String, Unit>,
+    scopes: Map<String, String>,
+    starts: Set<String>,
+}
+impl Headings {
+    fn head(&self, u: &Unit) -> Option<&Unit> {
+        self.heads.get(&u.id)
+    }
+    fn scope(&self, u: &Unit) -> String {
+        self.scopes
+            .get(&u.id)
+            .cloned()
+            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}\0{}\0", u.section(), u.title))
+    }
+    fn slots(&self, u: &Unit) -> String {
+        let h = self.head(u);
+        canonical(&json!(
+            u.spans
+                .iter()
+                .enumerate()
+                .map(|(k, sp)| {
+                    let slot = under(h, *sp)
+                        .map(|(j, _)| format!("c{j}"))
+                        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
+                            format!(
+                                "g{}",
+                                h.map(|h| h.spans.iter().filter(|s| s[1] <= sp[0]).count())
+                                    .unwrap_or(0)
+                            )
+                        });
+                    json!([slot, u.cells.as_ref().unwrap()[k]])
+                })
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        ))
+    }
+}
+fn row_headings(left: &[Unit], right: &[Unit]) -> [Headings; 2] {
+    let mut output = [
+        Headings {
+            heads: Map::new(),
+            scopes: Map::new(),
+            starts: Set::new(),
+        },
+        Headings {
+            heads: Map::new(),
+            scopes: Map::new(),
+            starts: Set::new(),
+        },
+    ];
+    let mut sides = vec![];
+    for (side, us) in [left, right].iter().enumerate() {
+        let mut current: Map<String, Unit> = Map::new();
+        let mut open: Map<String, (String, String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        let mut last: Map<String, (String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        let mut broken = Set::new();
+        let mut closed = Map::new();
+        let mut page = Map::new();
+        let mut count: Map<String, usize> = Map::new();
+        let mut table: Map<String, (String, usize)> = Map::new();
+        for u in *us {
+            if u.ambiguous {
+                continue;
+            }
+            if u.cells.is_none() {
+                if !["furniture", "page_heading", "footer", "whitespace"].contains(&u.role.as_str())
+                {
+                    current.clear();
+                    open.clear();
+                    closed.clear()
+                }
+                if ![
+                    "furniture",
+                    "page_heading",
+                    "footer",
+                    "whitespace",
+                    "heading",
+                ]
+                .contains(&u.role.as_str())
+                {
+                    broken.extend(last.keys().cloned());
+                }
+                continue;
+            }
+            let t = format!("{}\0{}", u.section(), u.title);
+            let st = open.get(&t).cloned();
+            let p = u.page();
+            let before = page.insert(t.clone(), p);
+            let ck = cell_key(u);
+            let label = st.is_some()
+                && names_identity(u)
+                && u.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().enumerate().any(|(k, c)| {
+                    identity_name(c)
+                        && !under(current.get(&t), u.spans[k])
+                            .map(|(_, t)| identity_heading(&t))
+                            .unwrap_or(false)
+                });
+            if (!test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw) || value_free(u))
+                && st.is_some()
+                && ck != st.as_ref().unwrap().0
+                && (label || (!names_identity(u) && names_column(u)))
+            {
+                current.shift_remove(&t);
+                open.shift_remove(&t);
+                broken.insert(t.clone());
+                let key = format!("{t}\0{ck}");
+                let n = count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0) + 1;
+                count.insert(key.clone(), n);
+                closed.insert(t.clone(), (key.clone(), n));
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (key, n));
+                continue;
+            }
+            if !test(r"\p{N}", &u.m.raw)
+                && st.is_some()
+                && ck != st.as_ref().unwrap().0
+                && !names_identity(u)
+            {
+                output[side].heads.insert(u.id.clone(), current[&t].clone());
+                let st = st.unwrap();
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (st.1, st.2));
+            } else if heading_like(u) {
+                let prev = last.get(&t);
+                let key = format!("{t}\0{ck}");
+                let n = if prev
+                    .map(|v| {
+                        v.0 == ck && !broken.contains(&t) && before.map(|b| p > b).unwrap_or(false)
+                    })
+                    .unwrap_or(false)
+                {
+                    prev.unwrap().1
+                } else {
+                    count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0) + 1
+                };
+                count.insert(key.clone(), n.max(*count.get(&key).unwrap_or(&0)));
+                last.insert(t.clone(), (ck.clone(), n));
+                broken.shift_remove(&t);
+                current.insert(t.clone(), u.clone());
+                open.insert(t.clone(), (ck, key.clone(), n));
+                closed.shift_remove(&t);
+                output[side].starts.insert(u.id.clone());
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), (key, n));
+            } else if let Some(h) = current.get(&t) {
+                output[side].heads.insert(u.id.clone(), h.clone());
+                table.insert(
+                    u.id.clone(),
+                    (format!("{t}\0{}", cell_key(h)), st.unwrap().2),
+                );
+            } else if let Some(c) = closed.get(&t) {
+                table.insert(u.id.clone(), c.clone());
+            }
+        }
+        sides.push((count, table));
+    }
+    for side in 0..2 {
+        for (id, (key, n)) in &sides[side].1 {
+            let scope = if sides.iter().all(|x| x.0.get(key) == Some(&1)) {
+                key.clone()
+            } else {
+                format!("{key}\0{side}\0{n}")
+            };
+            output[side].scopes.insert(id.clone(), scope);
+        }
+    }
+    output
+}
+fn identity_cells(r: &Unit, head: &Headings) -> Map<String, String> {
+    let h = head.head(r);
+    let mut cells = vec![];
+    for (k, c0) in r.cells.as_ref().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
+        let c = nfkc(c0);
+        let at = under(h, r.spans[k]);
+        let named = re(&format!(r"(?i)^(?:{ID})\b"))
+            .find(&c)
+            .ok()
+            .flatten()
+            .map(|m| m.as_str().to_lowercase())
+            .map(|n| if n == "s/n" { "serial".into() } else { n });
+        if let Some((j, t)) = &at {
+            if identity_heading(t) {
+                cells.push((format!("column {j}"), c));
+                continue;
+            }
+        }
+        if at.is_some()
+            || named.is_none()
+            || identity_name(&replace(r"[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$", trim(&c), ""))
+        {
+            continue;
+        }
+        cells.push((format!("named {}", named.unwrap()), c));
+    }
+    let crowded = cells
+        .iter()
+        .any(|(k, _)| cells.iter().filter(|(x, _)| x == k).count() > 1);
+    let mut m: Map<_, _> = cells
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(k, _)| cells.iter().filter(|(x, _)| x == k).count() == 1)
+        .cloned()
+        .collect();
+    let missing: Vec<_> = h
+        .map(|h| {
+            h.cells
+                .as_ref()
+                .unwrap()
+                .iter()
+                .enumerate()
+                .filter(|(j, t)| identity_heading(t) && !m.contains_key(&format!("column {j}")))
+                .map(|(j, _)| j)
+                .collect()
+        })
+        .unwrap_or_default();
+    let columns: Vec<_> = r
+        .spans
+        .iter()
+        .map(|sp| under(h, *sp).map(|(j, _)| j))
+        .collect();
+    let open = columns.iter().enumerate().any(|(k, j)| {
+        let Some(j) = j else { return true };
+        if columns.iter().filter(|x| *x == &Some(*j)).count() > 1 {
+            return true;
+        }
+        let [x0, x1] = r.spans[k];
+        let [h0, h1] = h.unwrap().spans[*j];
+        missing
+            .iter()
+            .any(|e| if e < j { x0 < h0 - 1. } else { x1 > h1 + 1. })
+    });
+    if crowded || (!missing.is_empty() && open) {
+        m.insert("incomplete".into(), String::new());
+    }
+    m
+}
+fn table_pairs(
+    la: &[Unit],
+    rb: &[Unit],
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    un: &mut Vec<V>,
+    l: &Doc,
+    r: &Doc,
+) {
+    let rows = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        group(us, &Set::new(), |u| {
+            if u.role == "cell" {
+                u.table_row.clone()
+            } else {
+                None
+            }
+        })
+        .into_values()
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+    };
+    let a = rows(la);
+    let b = rows(rb);
+    let mut da = Set::new();
+    let mut db = Set::new();
+    let unique = |rs: &Vec<Vec<Unit>>, primary: bool, v: &Option<String>| {
+        rs.iter()
+            .enumerate()
+            .filter(|(_, r)| {
+                v.is_some()
+                    && if primary {
+                        r[0].primary == *v
+                    } else {
+                        r[0].secondary == *v
+                    }
+            })
+            .map(|(i, _)| i)
+            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+    };
+    for (i, row) in a.iter().enumerate() {
+        let p = unique(&b, true, &row[0].primary);
+        let s = unique(&b, false, &row[0].secondary);
+        let op = unique(&a, true, &row[0].primary);
+        let os = unique(&a, false, &row[0].secondary);
+        if p.len() == 1 && s.len() == 1 && p[0] != s[0] {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let other = if op.len() == 1 && p.len() == 1 {
+            Some(p[0])
+        } else if os.len() == 1 && s.len() == 1 {
+            Some(s[0])
+        } else {
+            None
+        };
+        let Some(j) = other else { continue };
+        if db.contains(&j) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        da.insert(i);
+        db.insert(j);
+        for u in row {
+            if let Some(v) = b[j].iter().find(|v| v.path["field"] == u.path["field"]) {
+                let (mut u, mut v) = (u.clone(), v.clone());
+                u.path["confidence"] = json!("reliable");
+                v.path["confidence"] = json!("reliable");
+                bind(pairs, ul, ur, u, v, "declared-table-key", None);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let ra: Vec<_> = a
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .filter(|(i, _)| !da.contains(i))
+        .flat_map(|(_, r)| r.clone())
+        .collect();
+    let br: Vec<_> = b
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .filter(|(i, _)| !db.contains(i))
+        .flat_map(|(_, r)| r.clone())
+        .collect();
+    let duplicate = a.iter().enumerate().any(|(i, row)| {
+        !da.contains(&i)
+            && (unique(&a, true, &row[0].primary).len() > 1
+                || unique(&a, false, &row[0].secondary).len() > 1)
+    }) || b.iter().enumerate().any(|(i, row)| {
+        !db.contains(&i)
+            && (unique(&b, true, &row[0].primary).len() > 1
+                || unique(&b, false, &row[0].secondary).len() > 1)
+    });
+    if !ra.is_empty() && !br.is_empty() {
+        let fields: Set<_> = ra.iter().map(|u| s(&u.path["field"]).to_string()).collect();
+        for f in fields {
+            let aa: Vec<_> = ra
+                .iter()
+                .filter(|u| u.path["field"] == f)
+                .cloned()
+                .collect();
+            let bb: Vec<_> = br
+                .iter()
+                .filter(|u| u.path["field"] == f)
+                .cloned()
+                .collect();
+            if aa.is_empty() || bb.is_empty() {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let x = aggregate(&aa, format!("ambiguous-left-{f}"), true);
+            let y = aggregate(&bb, format!("ambiguous-right-{f}"), true);
+            mark(ul, &aa);
+            mark(ur, &bb);
+            un.push(unresolved(
+                "ambiguous_identity",
+                if duplicate {
+                    "表格主键或次级键重复；金额变化仍展示，无法确定唯一实体"
+                } else {
+                    "表格主次键冲突或缺少可靠对应"
+                },
+                &[x.clone()],
+                &[y.clone()],
+                l,
+                r,
+            ));
+            bind(pairs, ul, ur, x, y, "unresolved-table-group", None);
+        }
+    }
+}
+fn row_identity(
+    la: &[Unit],
+    rb: &[Unit],
+    heads: &[Headings; 2],
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    un: &mut Vec<V>,
+    l: &Doc,
+    r: &Doc,
+) {
+    let owners = |rows: &Vec<Unit>, h: &Headings| {
+        let mut m: Map<String, Vec<Unit>> = Map::new();
+        for row in rows {
+            let ids = identity_cells(row, h);
+            if row.ambiguous || ids.contains_key("incomplete") {
+                continue;
+            }
+            for (k, c) in ids {
+                if !value_like(&c) {
+                    m.entry(format!("{k}\0{c}")).or_default().push(row.clone())
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        m
+    };
+    let tables = |us: &[Unit], h: &Headings| {
+        group(us, &Set::new(), |u| u.cells.as_ref().map(|_| h.scope(u)))
+    };
+    let lt = tables(la, &heads[0]);
+    let rt = tables(rb, &heads[1]);
+    let mut links: Map<(usize, String), Set<(usize, String)>> = Map::new();
+    let mut via: Map<String, String> = Map::new();
+    for (t, rows) in lt {
+        let Some(other) = rt.get(&t) else { continue };
+        let ro = owners(other, &heads[1]);
+        for (key, aa) in owners(&rows, &heads[0]) {
+            let Some(bb) = ro.get(&key) else { continue };
+            if aa.len() != 1 || bb.len() != 1 {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let (a, b) = (&aa[0], &bb[0]);
+            if ul.contains(&a.id) || ur.contains(&b.id) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            links
+                .entry((0, a.id.clone()))
+                .or_default()
+                .insert((1, b.id.clone()));
+            links
+                .entry((1, b.id.clone()))
+                .or_default()
+                .insert((0, a.id.clone()));
+            via.entry(a.id.clone())
+                .or_insert_with(|| key.split('\0').nth(1).unwrap_or("").into());
+        }
+    }
+    let mut seen = Set::new();
+    for start in la {
+        let start = (0, start.id.clone());
+        if !links.contains_key(&start) || seen.contains(&start) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let mut g = vec![];
+        let mut queue = vec![start];
+        while let Some(u) = queue.pop() {
+            if !seen.insert(u.clone()) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            g.push(u.clone());
+            queue.extend(links.get(&u).unwrap().iter().cloned());
+        }
+        let mut aa: Vec<_> = g
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(s, _)| *s == 0)
+            .map(|(_, id)| la.iter().find(|u| u.id == *id).unwrap().clone())
+            .collect();
+        let mut bb: Vec<_> = g
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(s, _)| *s == 1)
+            .map(|(_, id)| rb.iter().find(|u| u.id == *id).unwrap().clone())
+            .collect();

+fn compare_repeated(
+    as_: &[Unit],
+    bs: &[Unit],
+    method: &str,
+    prefix: &str,
+    pairs: &mut Vec<Pair>,
+    ul: &mut Set<String>,
+    ur: &mut Set<String>,
+    singles: &mut Vec<(Option<Unit>, Option<Unit>)>,
+) {
+    let texts = |us: &[Unit]| group(us, &Set::new(), |u| Some(variant(u)));
+    let l = texts(as_);
+    let r = texts(bs);
+    if l.len() == 1 && r.len() == 1 {
+        let shown = |us: &[Unit], other: &str, id: String| {
+            let i = if l.keys().next() == r.keys().next() {
+                None
+            } else {
+                us.iter().position(|u| u.m.raw != other)
+            };
+            let mut order = us.to_vec();
+            if let Some(i) = i {
+                if i > 0 {
+                    let u = order.remove(i);
+                    order.insert(0, u)
+                }
+            }
+            let mut u = repeated(&order, id);
+            u.repeats = Some(us.to_vec());
+            u
+        };
+        let b = shown(bs, &as_[0].m.raw, format!("{prefix}-right-{}", bs[0].id));
+        let a = shown(as_, &b.m.raw, format!("{prefix}-left-{}", as_[0].id));
+        bind(pairs, ul, ur, a, b, method, None);
+        return;
+    }
+    let quote = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        format!(
+            "“{}”{}",
+            trim(&us[0].m.raw),
+            if us.iter().map(|u| trim(&u.m.raw)).collect::<Set<_>>().len() > 1 {
+                "等（页码随所在页）"
+            } else {
+                ""
+            }
+        )
+    };
+    for (own, other, is_right) in [(&r, &l, true), (&l, &r, false)] {
+        let (name, other_name) = if is_right {
+            ("待审版", "基准版")
+        } else {
+            ("基准版", "待审版")
+        };
+        let unchanged: Vec<_> = own
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|(t, _)| other.contains_key(*t))
+            .flat_map(|(_, us)| us.clone())
+            .collect();
+        for (text, us) in own {
+            if other.contains_key(text) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let kept = if other.len() == 1 {
+                other.values().next()
+            } else {
+                None
+            };
+            if kept.is_none() && own.len() == 1 {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let mut note = format!(
+                "本版组内文字不一致：{name}第 {} 页为{}文字",
+                page_list(us),
+                if is_right { "新" } else { "旧" }
+            );
+            if let Some(kept) = kept {
+                if !unchanged.is_empty() {
+                    note += &format!(
+                        "；{name}第 {} 页仍为{other_name}文字{}",
+                        page_list(&unchanged),
+                        quote(kept)
+                    );
+                }
+            } else {
+                note += &format!("，{other_name}没有相同文字")
+            };
+            let mut card = repeated(
+                us,
+                format!(
+                    "{prefix}-{}-{}",
+                    if is_right { "right" } else { "left" },
+                    us[0].id
+                ),
+            );
+            card.others = unchanged.clone();
+            card.separate = true;
+            card.note = note;
+            if let Some(kept) = kept {
+                let whole = repeated(
+                    kept,
+                    format!(
+                        "{prefix}-{}-{}",
+                        if is_right { "left" } else { "right" },
+                        kept[0].id
+                    ),
+                );
+                if is_right {
+                    bind(pairs, ul, ur, whole, card, method, None)
+                } else {
+                    bind(pairs, ul, ur, card, whole, method, None)
+                }
+            } else {
+                singles.push(if is_right {
+                    (None, Some(card))
+                } else {
+                    (Some(card), None)
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let one_sided = |own: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>, other: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>| {
+        own.keys().any(|t| !other.contains_key(t))
+    };
+    if (l.len() == 1 && one_sided(&r, &l)) || (r.len() == 1 && one_sided(&l, &r)) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (text, ls) in &l {
+        let Some(rs) = r.get(text) else { continue };
+        if rs.len() == ls.len() {
+            continue;
+        }
+        let others = |m: &Map<String, Vec<Unit>>| {
+            m.iter()
+                .filter(|(t, _)| *t != text)
+                .flat_map(|(_, us)| us.clone())
+                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        };
+        let lo = others(&l);
+        let ro = others(&r);
+        let mut note = "同一行的其他写法只作上下文，不计入本写法的次数".to_string();
+        if !lo.is_empty() {
+            note += &format!("：基准版第 {} 页", page_list(&lo))
+        }
+        if !ro.is_empty() {
+            note += &format!(
+                "{}待审版第 {} 页",
+                if lo.is_empty() { "：" } else { "；" },
+                page_list(&ro)
+            )
+        }
+        let mut a = repeated(ls, format!("{prefix}-left-{}", ls[0].id));
+        a.others = lo;
+        a.separate = true;
+        a.note = note;
+        let mut b = repeated(rs, format!("{prefix}-right-{}", rs[0].id));
+        b.others = ro;
+        b.separate = true;
+        bind(pairs, ul, ur, a, b, method, None);
+    }
+}
+struct Scoring<'a> {
+    budget: &'a V,
+    candidates: usize,
+    products: u64,
+    exhausted: bool,
+}
+impl Scoring<'_> {
+    fn score(&mut self, a: &Unit, b: &Unit, threshold: f64) -> Option<f64> {
+        let at = tokenize(&a.m.text);
+        let bt = tokenize(&b.m.text);
+        let denom = (at.len() + bt.len()) as f64;
+        if at.is_empty() || bt.is_empty() || 2. * at.len().min(bt.len()) as f64 / denom < threshold
+        {
+            return None;
+        }
+        let counts = |ts: &Vec<String>| {
+            let mut m: Map<String, usize> = Map::new();
+            for t in ts {
+                *m.entry(t.clone()).or_default() += 1
+            }
+            m
+        };
+        let ac = counts(&at);
+        let bc = counts(&bt);
+        let intersection: usize = ac
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(t, n)| (*n).min(*bc.get(t).unwrap_or(&0)))
+            .sum();
+        if 2. * intersection as f64 / denom < threshold {
+            return None;
+        }
+        if self.candidates as f64 >= n(&self.budget["candidates"])
+            || (self
+                .products
+                .saturating_add(work_product(at.len(), bt.len()))) as f64
+                > n(&self.budget["tokenProducts"])
+        {
+            self.exhausted = true;
+            return None;
+        }
+        self.candidates += 1;
+        self.products += work_product(at.len(), bt.len());
+        let v = 2. * lcs_length(&at, &bt) as f64 / denom;
+        if v >= threshold { Some(v) } else { None }
+    }
+}
+fn joint_align(
+    as_: &[Unit],
+    bs: &[Unit],
+    heads: &[Headings; 2],
+    sc: &mut Scoring,
+    threshold: f64,
+) -> Vec<(Vec<Unit>, Vec<Unit>, f64)> {
+    let _ = heads;
+    let w = bs.len() + 1;
+    let mut cost = vec![f64::INFINITY; (as_.len() + 1) * w];
+    let mut prev = vec![0; cost.len()];
+    let mut values = Map::new();
+    cost[0] = 0.;
+    let choices = [(1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1), (1, 0), (0, 1)];
+    let can_join = |a: &Unit, b: &Unit| {
+        a.order + 1 == b.order
+            && a.cells.is_none()
+            && b.cells.is_none()
+            && a.title == b.title
+            && a.section() == b.section()
+    };
+    let get = |us: &[Unit]| {
+        if us.len() == 1 {
+            us[0].clone()
+        } else {
+            aggregate(
+                us,
+                us.iter()
+                    .map(|u| {
+                        u.m.refs
+                            .iter()
+                            .flatten()
+                            .next()
+                            .map(|r| format!("{}:{}:{}", r.p, r.c, r.l))
+                            .unwrap_or(u.id.clone())
+                    })
+                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                    .join("+"),
+                false,
+            )
+        }
+    };
+    for i in 0..=as_.len() {
+        for j in 0..=bs.len() {
+            crate::checkpoint();
+            for (c, (di, dj)) in choices.iter().copied().enumerate() {
+                if i + di > as_.len()
+                    || j + dj > bs.len()
+                    || (di == 2 && !can_join(&as_[i], &as_[i + 1]))
+                    || (dj == 2 && !can_join(&bs[j], &bs[j + 1]))
+                {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                let value = if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+                    let aa = &as_[i..i + di];
+                    let bb = &bs[j..j + dj];
+                    if aa.iter().chain(bb).any(|u| u.cells.is_some()) {
+                        None
+                    } else {
+                        let a = get(aa);
+                        let b = get(bb);
+                        if a.title != b.title
+                            || a.section() != b.section()
+                            || as_
+                                .iter()
+                                .filter(|u| u.m.raw == a.m.raw && u.title == a.title)
+                                .count()
+                                > 1
+                            || bs
+                                .iter()
+                                .filter(|u| u.m.raw == b.m.raw && u.title == b.title)
+                                .count()
+                                > 1
+                        {
+                            None
+                        } else {
+                            sc.score(&a, &b, threshold)
+                        }
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    None
+                };
+                if di > 0 && dj > 0 && value.is_none() {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                let next = (i + di) * w + j + dj;
+                let v = cost[i * w + j]
+                    + if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+                        1. - value.unwrap() + 0.03 * (di + dj - 2) as f64
+                    } else {
+                        1.
+                    };
+                if v < cost[next] - 1e-12 {
+                    cost[next] = v;
+                    prev[next] = c + 1;
+                    if let Some(v) = value {
+                        values.insert(next, v);
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let (mut i, mut j) = (as_.len(), bs.len());
+    let mut out = vec![];
+    while i > 0 || j > 0 {
+        let c = prev[i * w + j];
+        if c == 0 {
+            break;
+        }
+        let (di, dj) = choices[c - 1];
+        if di > 0 && dj > 0 {
+            out.push((
+                as_[i - di..i].to_vec(),
+                bs[j - dj..j].to_vec(),
+                values[&(i * w + j)],
+            ));
+        }
+        i -= di;
+        j -= dj;
+    }
+    out.reverse();
+    out
+}

+use crate::{model::*, structure::*, text::*};

+#[derive(Clone)]
+struct Token {
+    start: usize,
+    end: usize,
+    text: String,
+}
+fn tokens(cs: &[char]) -> Vec<Token> {
+    let kind = |c: char| {
+        if test(r"\p{L}", &c.to_string()) {
+            'L'
+        } else if test(r"\p{N}", &c.to_string()) {
+            'N'
+        } else if ws(c) {
+            'S'
+        } else {
+            'P'
+        }
+    };
+    let mut out = vec![];
+    let mut k = 0;
+    while k < cs.len() {
+        let t = kind(cs[k]);
+        let mut e = k + 1;
+        if t != 'P' {
+            while e < cs.len()
+                && (kind(cs[e]) == t
+                    || (t == 'N'
+                        && ['.', ','].contains(&cs[e])
+                        && e + 1 < cs.len()
+                        && kind(cs[e + 1]) == 'N'))
+            {
+                e += 1
+            }
+        }
+        out.push(Token {
+            start: k,
+            end: e,
+            text: cs[k..e].iter().collect(),
+        });
+        k = e
+    }
+    out
+}
+#[derive(Clone)]
+struct Op {
+    kind: u8,
+    i: usize,
+    j: usize,
+    text: char,
+}
+struct Script<'a> {
+    x: &'a [char],
+    y: &'a [char],
+    prefix: usize,
+    ops: Vec<Op>,
+}
+impl Script<'_> {
+    fn equal(&mut self, i: usize, j: usize) {
+        self.ops.push(Op {
+            kind: 0,
+            i: self.prefix + i,
+            j: self.prefix + j,
+            text: self.x[i],
+        });
+    }
+    fn replaced(&mut self, i0: usize, i1: usize, j0: usize, j1: usize) {
+        for i in i0..i1 {
+            self.ops.push(Op {
+                kind: 1,
+                i: self.prefix + i,
+                j: self.prefix + j0,
+                text: self.x[i],
+            })
+        }
+        for j in j0..j1 {
+            self.ops.push(Op {
+                kind: 2,
+                i: self.prefix + i1,
+                j: self.prefix + j,
+                text: self.y[j],
+            })
+        }
+    }
+    fn chars(&mut self, mut i0: usize, i1: usize, mut j0: usize, j1: usize, spaces: bool) {
+        let same = |i, j| self.x[i] == self.y[j] && (!spaces || ws(self.x[i]));
+        let mut e = 0;
+        while i0 + e < i1 && j0 + e < j1 && same(i0 + e, j0 + e) {
+            e += 1
+        }
+        for k in 0..e {
+            self.equal(i0 + k, j0 + k)
+        }
+        i0 += e;
+        j0 += e;
+        let mut f = 0;
+        while i1 - f > i0
+            && j1 - f > j0
+            && self.x[i1 - 1 - f] == self.y[j1 - 1 - f]
+            && (!spaces || ws(self.x[i1 - 1 - f]))
+        {
+            f += 1
+        }
+        self.replaced(i0, i1 - f, j0, j1 - f);

+        }
+    }
+    fn stretch(
+        &mut self,
+        xc: &[Token],
+        yc: &[Token],
+        a0: usize,
+        a1: usize,
+        b0: usize,
+        b1: usize,
+        mut i0: usize,
+        i1: usize,
+        mut j0: usize,
+        j1: usize,
+    ) {
+        if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0 {
+            self.chars(i0, i1, j0, j1, true);

+        }
+        for k in 0..a1 - a0 {
+            let (u, v) = (&xc[a0 + k], &yc[b0 + k]);

+            self.chars(u.start, u.end, v.start, v.end, false);
+            i0 = u.end;
+            j0 = v.end
+        }
+        self.chars(i0, i1, j0, j1, false)
+    }

+    let mut s = 0;

+        s += 1
+    }
+    let prefix = if p > 0 { at[p - 1].end } else { 0 };
+    let suffix = if s > 0 {

+    } else {

+    };
+    let x = &aa[prefix..aa.len() - suffix];
+    let y = &bb[prefix..bb.len() - suffix];
+    let mut script = Script {

+        y,
+        prefix,
+        ops: (0..prefix)

+                j: i,

+            .collect(),
+    };
+    let shift = |t: &Token| Token {

+        text: t.text.clone(),
+    };
+    let xc: Vec<_> = at[p..at.len() - s]

+        }
+        script.stretch(
+            &xc,
+            &yc,
+            ta,
+            xc.len(),
+            tb,
+            yc.len(),
+            ci,
+            x.len(),
+            cj,
+            y.len(),

+    }
+    for k in (1..=suffix).rev() {
+        script.ops.push(Op {
+            kind: 0,
+            i: aa.len() - k,
+            j: bb.len() - k,
+            text: aa[aa.len() - k],

+    }
+    let mut groups: Vec<Vec<Op>> = vec![];

+        } else {

+        }
+    }

+}
